responsibility: Implements C++ exception-handling semantics in the front end. It declares and uses the runtime support entry points for throwing and catching, builds EH typeinfo references and exception object operations, checks throw/catch operand admissibility, represents and evaluates exception specifications and noexcept expressions, determines whether expressions and function types are non-throwing, and injects return-value cleanup machinery needed when potentially throwing cleanups interact with nontrivial destructors.
